items.title: Reading connections for the newest entries

browser_flow: Keyboard-created Stone, sea and makers as a separate journey with five unscheduled ideas.
Existing Chilika day 1 and original note preserved.
New Bhubaneswar note survived navigation and creating Northern stories as another journey.
Five total test journeys visible; existing main-origin plans untouched.
Odia Puri query returned one matching entry at all three viewports.

limitations: Implementation self-review, not independent editorial review or accessibility certification.
Selections reuse existing research; no verified route, journey duration, opening arrangement or booking availability is asserted.
Odia guide headings and search aliases still await native-language proofreading.
Viewport emulation and keyboard interactions checked; physical devices and screen readers not tested.
Storage failure and invalid-data paths tested at library level; quota exhaustion was not forced in the user browser.
No publication, paid service, outreach or cross-project adoption.
